exact_scope: Any existing ordinary grand-canonical DLR point-process law in R^d at finite z,beta with nonnegative pair potential and empty energy zero has conditional void probability at least exp(-z|B|); disjoint equal-volume B_i obey P(all occupied)<=(1-exp(-z|B|))^m; hence arbitrarily large holes and no globally bounded displacement from any full-rank lattice almost surely.
source_quote: For every bounded B and P-almost every exterior, 1 <= Xi_B(eta) <= exp(z |B|)
remaining_gap: Does not establish existence of a non-translation-invariant Riesz Gibbs state; does not cover neutralized long-range s<=3.
